cfg.secretFilePatterns: Extra file name or path patterns (globs, for example "*.cred" or "config/private/**") that Programming IME treats as secret-class files: it asks before it reads such a file. They add to the built-in rules (.env, private keys, keystores, credentials ...), which cannot be switched off. A pattern without a slash matches the file name; with a slash it matches the path from any folder; a trailing slash means everything below. User settings only: a workspace cannot weaken this list.
